description: List vendors in the built-in registry, optionally filtered by category or name search. Returns slug, display name, category, and status page URL for each entry. Use to discover the correct slug to pass to other tools, or to see which vendors are available before configuring a stack.

category.description: Filter to one category: cloud, cdn-edge, dev-platform, data, comms, auth, monitoring, or ai.

query.description: Free-text search against vendor name and slug. Case-insensitive. E.g., "cloud", "auth", "slack".

name: devops_list_vendors

categories.description: All available category values for use in the category filter.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

vendors.description: Matching vendors from the built-in registry.

items.description: A vendor entry from the built-in registry.

slug.description: Use this as the vendor identifier in other tools.

statuspage_url.description: Status page base URL — the Statuspage API base for Statuspage-backed vendors, the public status page URL for adapter-backed vendors (aws, gcp, azure, gitlab, slack, neon, redis-cloud).

title: Devops List Vendors
